releaseNotes: 2026 Supercar & GT Racing Dashboard: 1) Large, beautiful central digital GPS speed display encircled by an authentic 250° precision RPM tachometer arc with calibrated graduation ticks and subtle redline sector. 2) Pure OLED deep black background with radial vignette depth, premium white typography, electric cyan accents, and restrained redline highlights. 3) Symmetrical sequential F1/GT3 shift lights across the dial crown. 4) Compact, neatly aligned telemetry wings for Trip, Peak Velocity, GPS precision, BLE link, battery volts, and coolant temperature. 5) Strict sensor integrity: never fabricates missing sensor data.
